overview.mechanism: Reversibly inhibits gastric H+/K+-ATPase through potassium-competitive blockade, suppressing gastric acid secretion.
uses: Studied for healing erosive esophagitis; Philippine-approved uses and regimens should be checked in the insert.

paragraphs.text: A randomized eight-week trial reported noninferior erosive-esophagitis healing with fexuprazan compared with esomeprazole. This was an acid-reflux study, not a renal-impairment or dialysis dosing trial.

Efficacy in erosive esophagitis does not establish dosing in severe CKD or prove suitability for every acid-related indication. A separate retracted fexuprazan publication was excluded from this summary.

sources.citation: Lee et al. Randomized controlled trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of fexuprazan compared with esomeprazole in erosive esophagitis. World J Gastroenterol. 2022;28:6294–6309. PubMed PMID: 36504556.

revision_log.change: Source-linked descriptive overview and clinical evidence; no new unsupported dose recommendation or inferred dialysis schedule.
